thread:
rachel: FYI 1  ACME pilot asks: sustain 45k qps bursts (3-7m windows) in us-west with p95 <120ms for short prompts. They're on Dedicated and require CMK. Need cross-team plan for prewarm, fallback, and pricing. Can we triage?
ben (eng-runtime): I can join. Clarify: is 45k peak or steady for the window? Also what's the model and avg token length?
anya (customer-success): They're using our 7B family, avg prompt ~60 tokens, responses short. Peak is expected during onboarding flows, so bursty. They also want rollback criteria in case of quality regressions.
ivy (eng-infra): Dedicated + CMK = extra boot latency for new nodes. Prewarm is mandatory for strict p95. We need to size reserved burst capacity; rough estimate: 10-14 x V100/A100 equivalents depending on model memory.
maria (security): CMK note: customer-managed keys via their KMS. We must ensure envelope encryption + key access role. That will add ~20-90s to new node initialization if we do HSM unwrap per boot.
dan (sre): Runbook implications: warm pool, health probes, and evict policies. Also recommend graceful fallback to quantized variant and documented customer-visible behavior.
ben (eng-runtime): Runtime changes I'd propose: 1) per-tenant prefix/KV caching and sticky hot workers 2) adaptive batching boundaries: lower max batch size under tight latency budget 3) transparent fallback router that flips to 8-bit variant when p95 breaches threshold and adds response header x-model-fallback. I can prototype the router + header.
ivy (eng-infra): Infra asks: - reserve burst pool (estimate 12 GPUs) for pilot windows - implement autoscaler prewarm hook to spin warm workers ahead of traffic - network/egress validation in region - billing plan add-on for reserved hours.
maria (security): I will produce the CMK onboarding checklist and list of IAM roles we need. ETA ~3 business days to finish certs for a pilot. If we require node-level access to KMS on boot, note the cold-start risk.
dan (sre): We should build a three-level customer promise: Committed (guaranteed 45k), Best-effort with documented fallback, and Observability-only (no guarantee). Product can pick.
rachel: Product ask: give us acceptance criteria per level and rough cost uplift. Also want telemetry for fallback rate and user-visible latency at token-level.
ben (eng-runtime): I'll scope a dev prototype of fallback routing + kv cache in 48h and a perf delta for 8-bit vs fp16 in 36h.
ivy (eng-infra): I'll run a cost sim matrix for Committed/Silver/Bronze by EOD tomorrow and validate region capacity in 48h.
maria (security): I'll post CMK checklist and the expected boot latency numbers in this thread in 48h.
dan (sre): I'll draft the runbook and initial load test plan; can run a staging spike next week (avoid deploy freeze).
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze Thu 17:00 - Fri 09:00 UTC. Any autoscaler changes should be staged before freeze.
rachel: Decision checkpoint: 48h. If Committed chosen, we need infra + security sign-off to meet pilot start. Otherwise offer Silver with explicit fallback and pricing add-on.
anya (customer-success): I'll prep customer-facing messaging for Silver and Committed tiers and surface any ACME constraints.
ben (eng-runtime): +1 to checkpoint. Will post prototype link and perf numbers here.
ivy (eng-infra): 44d
maria (security): 4e6 will post checklist.
dan (sre): :hammer_and_wrench: starting runbook draft.
